# HR Policy Updates and Reviews

This document outlines key HR policy and process updates required:

*   Monitor the annual leave standard update.
*   Review the medical insurance based on audit.
*   Optimize the medical insurance urgently.
*   Update the annual leave for strategy 2026.
*   Update the bonus structure quarterly.
